g.text: AKIS spending, % of value of agricultural production
Public spending on agricultural knowledge and innovation (AKIS), % of farm output
value. Real spending (GDP deflator) fell in 10 of 28; in 11 more it rose, but less
Research and extension spending grew more slowly than farm
output: its share fell in 22 of 29 economies
* Public stockholding is a large part of general services support here; it is not counted as AKIS.
